findings.message: Query optimization practice (Day 2) says 'The SET STATISTICS IO comparison moves to Day 4', but the Day 4 Indexing practice contains no offset-versus-keyset SET STATISTICS IO step, and Optional Extensions lists that run as trimmed and unscheduled. The plan contradicts itself.
findings.fix: Change the Day 2 note to say the SET STATISTICS IO paging comparison is an optional extension (or fit it into Day 4 within the 30-minute limit and remove it from Optional Extensions).

findings.message: AsNoTracking is studied on Day 5 and is absent from spaced revision: the Day 5 revision rereads only the 'Observe' notes from Days 1-4, so AsNoTracking appears only in the same-day mock question. Every other mandatory topic gets a later review.
findings.fix: Optionally include the Day 5 AsNoTracking measurements in the Day 5 revision note, or move AsNoTracking earlier so it is reviewed on a later day. Keep each day at 30 minutes.

findings.message: The Day 2 revision is described as happening 'Before the new topic', but the Schedule lists it as row 3, after Query optimization (row 2).
findings.fix: Make the row order and the revision text agree (swap rows 2 and 3, or reword the text).

findings.message: Assumption 12 (all five topics are High priority because they are derived priorities; the derived support topic is Low) is not restated under Assumptions, although the plan's time split depends on it (AsNoTracking gets 15 minutes against 25-30 for the others; the derived topic gets no session). The plan does justify the AsNoTracking split in Time Budget.
findings.fix: Add one Assumptions bullet repeating assumption 12 and linking it to the per-topic time split.

optional_recommendations: Buffering versus streaming (ToListAsync versus AsAsyncEnumerable) as a Middle+ Query optimization talking point; it needs research findings before the plan can give content.
Provider-specific plan reading for PostgreSQL (EXPLAIN ANALYZE) if the target company turns out not to use SQL Server; not researched.
